takeaways.text: Lines up **Slot** on **60%** of 139 plays (n=84); also Wide (outside) 38% (n=53).
Runs a route on **99%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **11.3 yd** downfield by the throw (n=138, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Slot (60%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (9.3 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
